list.title: Communities
list.intro: Questions and discussions among colleagues, by subspecialty. Everyone writes under their own name, and what is written stays to be found later.
list.staffNote: Med Connect’s staff can read every community.
list.posts: {count, plural, =0 {No posts yet} one {# post} other {# posts}}
list.feedEmpty: Nothing yet from the communities you follow. Follow a community to see its new posts here.
list.verifiedOnly: Communities are open to people whose account has been verified as a physician or a medical student.

community.followHint: New posts appear in your feed and among your notices.
community.empty: No posts yet. Be the first to write.
community.banned: A moderator stopped you from writing here: {reason}
community.bannedUntil: A moderator stopped you from writing here until {date}: {reason}
community.archived: This community is closed. It can be read, not written in.
community.noBans: Nobody is stopped from writing here.

post.comments: {count, plural, =0 {No comments} one {# comment} other {# comments}}
post.deleteConfirm: Delete it? The text is removed and a note stays in its place.
post.followPostHint: You are told about new comments.
post.reportTitle: Report it to Med Connect’s staff
post.reported: Thank you. The staff will look at it.
post.lockedNote: This post is locked: no more comments.
post.removeReason: The reason, shown with the note
post.banDays: For how many days (empty: until lifted)

write.title: Write a post
write.filesHint: Never a picture or a document of a patient.
write.patientNote: Never write anything that identifies a patient: no name, ID number, date of birth, phone number, record number or picture. A check looks for these before sending; it helps, but it is no guarantee.
write.found: Change these before sending; they look like a patient’s details:

admin.title: Communities
admin.intro: A community for each subspecialty, and others you open. Moderators keep each one: they remove posts and comments, lock posts, and stop someone writing.
admin.slugHint: Lower-case English letters, digits and dashes, as in “residents-corner”.
admin.posts: {count, plural, =0 {No posts} one {# post} other {# posts}}
admin.moderatorEmailHint: A verified person with a name.
admin.notFound: No verified person has this address.
admin.roomsNote: Chat rooms closed when communities came: every room is archived. Staff can still read one from the chat reports.
